$comment: Adjudicated non-defects for db/gates/check-documentation-schema-drift.mjs.
Every entry is keyed on a SITE -- (path, table, column) for gate 1, or
(path, statement_contains) for gate 2 -- and NEVER on a column name alone.
Judging per (table, column) is the difference between fixing and breaking:
pff_player_seasonlogs.pff_id survives while player.pff_id does not, and
scoring_format_player_seasonlogs.year survives while player_seasonlogs.year
does not. A name-keyed entry here would be the stoplist that hid a real
defect in check-renamed-column-consumers, which returned 129 findings with
not one of them `total` over a rename that wiped a year of projection values.
An entry that no longer suppresses anything is reported as a FINDING, so a
repaired or deleted site forces its entry out rather than leaving a standing
exemption. Do not add an entry to quiet a gate you have not read.
kind = history      accurate past-tense record of what a rename DID; only
live instruction counts as a defect
kind = not_a_column the token is a real thing that is not a database column
(a config key, a JS property, a spec basename, a value)
kind = fragment     a documented block that continues a structure an EARLIER
block defined, so it names a relation that is real in the
doc's narrative and absent from any schema. Record which
block defines it, so the entry falls when that one moves.
